analyst.summary: Inox Wind manufactures wind turbines and has completed a genuine turnaround after several loss-making years, now on its eighth consecutive profitable quarter with a growing order book supported by India's wind-energy capacity push. The historical growth and quality figures on file look poor mainly because they still reflect the older loss-making period rather than the company's current run-rate. The business remains working-capital intensive and still carries meaningful debt, so while the turnaround looks real, it is not yet a fully proven, low-risk story.
